# Single-cell analysis - Myeloid classification

Here, we will perform the third single cell analysis steps, including myeloid phenotyping.

## Read in data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")
sce
```

## Filter sce for myeloid cells

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
#based on immune MC categories
sce <- sce[,sce$immune_metacluster %in% c("Macrophage","Neutrophil")]
sce
```

```{r}
# Cluster channel marker correlation (all markers - does not show distribution which is usually recommended)
cur_sce <- sce#[,sce$immune_metacluster == "Macrophage"]

cor_sce <- as.data.frame(t(assay(cur_sce,"exprs")[rowData(cur_sce)$myeloid_cluster,]))

corrplot(cor(cor_sce,method = "pearson"), method="color", col=brewer.pal(n=8, name="RdBu"),  
         type="upper", order="hclust",hclust.method = "ward.D2", 
         addCoef.col = "black", addCoefasPercent = F,# Add coefficient of correlation
         tl.col="black", tl.srt=40, #Text label color and rotation
         # Combine with significance
         #p.mat = , sig.level = 0.01, insig = "blank", 
         # hide correlation coefficient on the principal diagonal
         diag=F
)

# For specific markers of interest (also shows the value distribution which is recommended)
#pairs.panels(cor_sce[,c("CK5","KRT14")],
#             method = "spearman",
#             hist.col = "royalblue1",
#             digits = 2)
```



```{r, fig.height=25, fig.width=6}
plotExpression(sce, 
               features = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster],
               x = "my_cluster_names", 
               exprs_values = "exprs", 
               colour_by = "my_cluster_names") +
    theme(axis.text.x =  element_text(angle = 90))+
    scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_names)
```

# 1. Clustering

## Define markers for clustering

```{r immune_markers, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# We will again use predefined markers 
# Option 1: 
rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD68","CD11c","MPO", "CD16","HLADR","TMEM173","CD303","CD163","IDO1","DCLAMP","CD11b","MMP9","CCR2","CD274","Arginase","CD33","VISTA","CD209", "CD206","CD15")

#Option 2:
rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_1 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD68","CD11c","MPO", "CD16","HLADR","CD163","CD11b","MMP9","CCR2","Arginase","CD33","CD209", "CD206","CD15") #kick out IDO1, CD274, TMEM173, DC_LAMP, VISTA, CD303

#Option 3: 
rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_2 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD68","CD11c","MPO", "CD16","HLADR","CD303","CD163","CD11b","MMP9","CCR2","Arginase","CD33","CD209", "CD206","CD15") #kick out IDO1, CD274, TMEM173, DC_LAMP, VISTA

#Option 4: 
rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_3 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD68","CD11c","MPO", "CD16","HLADR","CD163","CD11b","MMP9","CCR2","Arginase","CD33","CD209", "CD206","CD15","CD38") #kick out IDO1, CD274, TMEM173, DC_LAMP, VISTA # include CD38
```

## Run clustering

### Graph-based 

Next, we will run Rphenoannoy (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm) clustering with different resolution parameters. 

```{r cluster, message=FALSE}
library(Rphenoannoy)
set.seed(22)

mat <- t(assay(sce, "exprs")[rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster,])

#k=30
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 30)

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_30 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_30)

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

gc()

#k=50
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 50)

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_50 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_50)

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

gc()

#k=70
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 70)

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_70 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_70)

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

gc()

#k=90
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 90)

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_90 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_90)

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

gc()

#k=110
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 110)

my_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$my_cluster_110 <- my_clusters

unique(sce$my_cluster_110)

#Save SCEs after my_clustering
```

### FlowSOM 

Not very useful in this scenario. 

```{r}
library(CATALYST)

# Run FlowSOM and ConsensusClusterPlus clustering
set.seed(220410)
sce <- cluster(sce, 
               features = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster],
               maxK = 30)

# Assess cluster stability
delta_area(sce)

delta_area(sce)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,0.1), xlim = c(4, 25))# select k = 8

#saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")
```

```{r}
# Add new SOM clusters to SCE (select pretty high k for "overclustering")
sce$my_cluster_som_16 <- cluster_ids(sce, "meta16")
sce$my_cluster_som_21 <- cluster_ids(sce, "meta21")
```








```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")
```


### Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r}
#Pairwise rand index 
#Agreement between two clustering approaches - ARI > 0.5 = "good" similarity
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_30,sce$my_cluster_50, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_50,sce$my_cluster_70, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_70,sce$my_cluster_90, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_90,sce$my_cluster_110, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$my_cluster_110,sce$my_cluster_130, mode = "index")
```

```{r clustree, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"my_cluster_[:digit:]")]
my_clusters <- my_clusters[!str_detect(my_clusters, "_1_")]
my_clusters <- my_clusters[!str_detect(my_clusters, "_2_")]
my_clusters <- my_clusters[!str_detect(my_clusters, "_3_")]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,3]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "myeloid_cluster")
}

my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"my_cluster_1_[:digit:]")]

df_1 <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,4]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "myeloid_cluster_1")
}

my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"my_cluster_2_[:digit:]")]

df_2 <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,4]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "myeloid_cluster_2")
}

my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"my_cluster_3_[:digit:]")]

df_3 <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,4]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "myeloid_cluster_3")
}

df_out <- rbind(df, df_1, df_2, df_3)


p1 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=num_clus, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")

p2 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=rmsd, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")

  geom_line(aes(k, sil))+
```

```{r astir-expo}

write.csv(expr_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/06_my/expr_ccRCC_myeloid_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

`Next: Run Astir in Python.`

```{r}
#Import Astir cell type assignments

rowData(sce)$use_astir_myeloid <- rowData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(use_astir = ifelse(rownames(sce) %in% astir_myeloid_channel,TRUE,FALSE)) %>% pull(use_astir)
```

# 3. GMM for all type-relevant markers 

```{r}
## Gaussian mixture model for all markers relevant for initial celltype assignment 
type_markers <- rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_1]

plot_list <- list()

library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 14)

out_list <- foreach (x = type_markers) %dopar%{ #replace with for-loop to also access plot_list (slower)
  
  GMM_marker <- Mclust(assay(sce, "exprs")[x,], G = 2)
  
  GMM_df <- data.frame(class_marker = ifelse(GMM_marker$classification == 2 & GMM_marker$uncertainty < 0.01, paste0(x, "_pos"), paste0(x, "_neg")), 
                     marker_exprs = assay(sce, "exprs")[x,],
                     uncertainty = GMM_marker$uncertainty)
  
  plot_list[[x]] <- ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = marker_exprs))+
  geom_density()+
  geom_rug(aes(color = class_marker))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
  
  return(GMM_df$class_marker)
}

for (i in seq_along(out_list)){
  colData(sce)[,paste0(type_markers[i],"_GMM")] <- out_list[[i]]
}
```

```{r}
# Convert the data.frame 
data_dt <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select("HLADR_GMM", "CD11b_GMM","CD15_GMM","CD163_GMM","Arginase_GMM") 

data_numeric_out <- data_dt %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(str_detect(., "_pos")))) %>% 
  mutate(CD11b_CD15_Arginase_GMM = ifelse(CD11b_GMM & CD15_GMM & Arginase_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # MDSC = CD11b+ / CD15+ / Arginase+
  mutate(CD11b_GMM_new = ifelse(CD11b_GMM & !CD15_GMM & !Arginase_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # C_M = CD11b+ / CD15- / Arginase-
  select(-CD15_GMM, -Arginase_GMM, -CD11b_GMM) %>% 
  mutate(sum = rowSums(.)) %>% filter(sum == 1) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:5, names_to = "GMM", values_to = "count") %>% 
  filter(count == 1) %>% select(cell_id, GMM)

data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD163_GMM"] <- "M2_like"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "HLADR_GMM"] <- "Ag_M"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD11b_CD15_Arginase_GMM"] <- "Neutro_MDSC"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD11b_GMM_new"] <- "C_M"

#Add to sce
sce$GMM_myeloid_combined <- data_numeric_out$GMM[match(sce$cell_id, data_numeric_out$cell_id)]

sce$GMM_myeloid_combined[is.na(sce$GMM_myeloid_combined)] <- "Unknown/Other"

# GMM per category
GMM_sum <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(GMM_myeloid_combined) %>% dplyr::count()
GMM_sum
```




# 4. Myeloid metacluster

### Rich heatmap 

Heatmap of clusters

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and GMM
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
sce$my_cluster_selected <- sce$my_cluster_1_90
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$my_cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$myeloid_cluster_1)

#state_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$my_cluster_selected,
#                                 statistics = "mean",
#                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
#                                 subset.row = rownames(sce) %in% c("CD274","IDO1","VISTA","TMEM173"))

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over my_cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, my_cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-my_cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(my_cluster_selected = spatial$my_cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir / GMM prediction 

## Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_selected,astir_myeloid_combined) %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = my_cluster_selected,names_from = astir_myeloid_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

#Create colors for astir cell types 
astir_col <- setNames(c("#E31A1C","#A6CEE3","#FB9A99","#FDBF6F","#33A02C","#CAB2D6"), 
                      c("M2_like", "C_M", "Neutro_MDSC", "M1_like", "Ag_M","Unknown/Other"))

#astir_col <- setNames(c("#E31A1C", "#EB4445", "#F36F6F", "#FB9A99", "#CA7194", "#994A8F", "#68228B"), 
#                     c("M2_like", "M1_like", "Neutro_MDSC","Granu", "C_M", "Ag_M", "Other"))

metadata(sce)$colors$my_astir_col <- astir_col
metadata(sce)$colors$my_astir_col <- metadata(sce)$colors$my_astir_col[match(colnames(astir_anno),names(metadata(sce)$colors$my_astir_col))]

## GMM cell types per cluster
GMM_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_selected,GMM_myeloid_combined) %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(my_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = my_cluster_selected,names_from = GMM_myeloid_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("my_cluster_selected")

#Create colors for GMM cell types

#                     c("M2_like", "M1_like", "Neutro_MDSC","Granu", "C_M", "Ag_M", "Other"))

metadata(sce)$colors$my_GMM_col <- GMM_col
metadata(sce)$colors$my_GMM_col <- metadata(sce)$colors$my_GMM_col[match(colnames(GMM_anno),names(metadata(sce)$colors$my_GMM_col))]

ha_GMM_astir <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  astir_myeloid = anno_barplot(astir_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$my_astir_col)),

                                                                                      ))))) %>% mutate(my_metacluster = as.factor(my_metacluster))

#Create colors for myeloid metacluster
meta_col <- setNames(c("#E31A1C","#A6CEE3","#FB9A99","#FDBF6F","#33A02C"), 
                      c("M2_like", "C_M", "Neutro_MDSC", "M1_like", "Ag_M"))

#meta_col <- setNames(c("#E31A1C", "#EB4445", "#F36F6F", "#FB9A99", "#CA7194", "#994A8F", "#68228B"), 
#                      c("M2_like", "M1_like", "Neutro_MDSC","Granu", "C_M", "Ag_M", "Other"))

metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster <- meta_col

### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs")),
        col = col_main,
        name = "exprs",
        row_title = NULL,
        show_row_names = TRUE, 
        show_row_dend = TRUE,
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  TRUE,
        row_split = anno$my_metacluster,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        cluster_row_slices = TRUE)+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs"))))+
  #Heatmap(t(assay(state_sce, "exprs")), col = col_main)+
  rowAnnotation(metacluster = anno_simple(unfactor(anno$my_metacluster), col = metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster, border = TRUE))+
  ha_GMM_astir+
  rowAnnotation(names = anno_text(anno$my_cluster_names))+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta


# Create legends for annotation 
lgd <- Legend(title = "metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster), 
               legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster))
 
lgd_1 <- Legend(title = "astir/GMM", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$my_astir_col), 
               legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$my_astir_col))

# Draw heatmap
draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd, lgd_1))

## Add myeloid_metacluster to SCE 
sce$myeloid_metacluster <- anno$my_metacluster[match(sce$my_cluster_selected, anno$my_cluster_selected)]
sce$my_cluster_names <- as.factor(anno$my_cluster_names[match(sce$my_cluster_selected, anno$my_cluster_selected)])

colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(myeloid_metacluster) %>% count()
```

#### Fraction correlation 

```{r}
# METACLUSTER 

## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_metacluster <- SID_metacluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_metacluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_metacluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = myeloid_metacluster,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("myeloid_metacluster")
cor <- cor(SID, method = "spearman")
#cor[2] # only works for two images per patient 
n <- length(colnames(SID))
if(n > 1){
mean(cor[2:n,1])
}else{NA}
}

SID_metacluster_cor <- as.data.frame(SID_metacluster_cor) 
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- unique(colData(sce)$PID) 
SID_metacluster_cor$category <- "PID"
out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
SID_metacluster_cor$n_images <- out$n[match(SID_metacluster_cor$PID, out$PID)]

# Filter samples with 1 image only - Correlation = NA 
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(n_images > 1)

SID_metacluster_cor_plot <- ggplot(SID_metacluster_cor, aes(x = category, y = V1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = n_images), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 6))+
  ylab("Correlation of metacluster fractions per PID (n=2-6)")+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman rho = ",round(median(SID_metacluster_cor$V1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))

SID_metacluster_cor_plot
```

#### CATALYST-based visualization

We will first convert the sce into a CATALYST-compatible format.

```{r CATALYST}
library(CATALYST)
# save spe in CATALYST-compatible object with renamed colData entries and 
# new metadata information
sce_cat <- sce 
sce_cat$sample_id <- factor(sce$PID)
sce_cat$cluster_id <- factor(sce$myeloid_metacluster)

#add celltype information to metadata
metadata(sce_cat)$cluster_codes <- data.frame(myeloid_metacluster = factor(sce_cat$myeloid_metacluster))
```

```{r CATALYST pbmds and clrDR, message=FALSE}
# MDS pseudobulk by myeloid_metacluster
pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "cluster_id", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$myeloid_cluster_1], 
      label_by = "cluster_id", k = "myeloid_metacluster") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$myeloid_metacluster)+
  theme_classic()

# MDS pseudobulk by myeloid_metacluster
pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "both", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$myeloid_cluster_1], 
      k = "myeloid_metacluster",
      size_by = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$myeloid_metacluster)+
  theme_classic()

# CLR of patient proportions per myeloid_metacluster
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "cluster_id", k = "myeloid_metacluster", 
      label_by = "cluster_id", arrow_col = "PID", 
      point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$myeloid_metacluster, 
      arrows = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()

# CLR of myeloid_metacluster proportions per patient
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "sample_id", point_col = "sample_id",
      k = "myeloid_metacluster", point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$myeloid_metacluster)+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme_classic()
```

# 5. Myeloid neighborhood

NOTE: Neighborhood detection did not work as intended. One neighborhood contains most cells, which is hard to interpret. 


## Filter for myeloid low images 

```{r}
# Filter samples that contain at least 5 myeloid cells
cur_sample <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% count() %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(mean(n)) %>% arrange(n) %>% filter(n >=5) %>% pull(sample_id)

sce_spatial <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
```

## Build different spatial graphs 

```{r}
## Aggregate neighbors
# Build spatial knn graph
sce_spatial <- buildSpatialGraph(sce_spatial, img_id = "sample_id", type = "knn", k = 20, 
                         coords = c("Pos_X",  "Pos_Y"),
                         max_dist = 30,
                         name = "knn_20",
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 20))

sce_spatial <- buildSpatialGraph(sce_spatial, img_id = "sample_id", type = "knn", k = 40, 
                         coords = c("Pos_X",  "Pos_Y"),
                         max_dist = 60,
                         name = "knn_40",
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 20))

sce_spatial <- buildSpatialGraph(sce_spatial, img_id = "sample_id", type = "expansion", 
                                 threshold = 20,
                         coords = c("Pos_X",  "Pos_Y"),
                         name = "expansion_20",
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 20))

sce_spatial <- buildSpatialGraph(sce_spatial, img_id = "sample_id", type = "expansion", 
                                 threshold = 40,
                         coords = c("Pos_X",  "Pos_Y"),
                         name = "expansion_40",
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 20))

## Neighborhood graph already build with steinbock 
```

## Detect CN

In the next section, we will define cellular neighborhoods by clustering myeloid cells based on their neighboring cells.

### Based on Metacluster

```{r neighborhood-1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(imcRtools)
library(bluster)

# Aggregate neighbors 
### A: KNN graph
sce_spatial <- aggregateNeighbors(sce_spatial, colPairName = "knn_20", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "myeloid_metacluster", proportions = FALSE, name = "count_knn_20")

sce_spatial <- aggregateNeighbors(sce_spatial, colPairName = "knn_40", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "myeloid_metacluster", proportions = FALSE, name = "count_knn_40")

### B: Neighborhood expansion graph
sce_spatial <- aggregateNeighbors(sce_spatial, colPairName = "neighborhood", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "myeloid_metacluster", proportions = FALSE, name = "count_steinbock")

sce_spatial <- aggregateNeighbors(sce_spatial, colPairName = "expansion_20", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "myeloid_metacluster", proportions = FALSE, name = "count_exp_20")

sce_spatial <- aggregateNeighbors(sce_spatial, colPairName = "expansion_40", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "myeloid_metacluster", proportions = FALSE, name = "count_exp_40")
```

```{r}
# A) Perform cluster sweep for kmeans (silhouette width, wcss)
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 5)

out_test <- foreach(i = c("count_knn_20","count_knn_40","count_steinbock", "count_exp_40", "count_exp_20"), .combine = rbind)%dopar%{

set.seed(22)
clust_list <- lapply(2:20, function(k){
  cur_km <- kmeans(colData(sce_spatial)[,i], centers = k, nstart = 10)
  return(list(wss = sum(cur_km$withinss),
           clusters = cur_km$cluster))
})

sil <- vapply(lapply(clust_list, `[[`, 2), 
              function(x) mean(approxSilhouette(colData(sce_spatial)[,i], x)$width), 
              0)

data.frame(k = 2:20, 
           sil = sil,
```

```{r}
# A) Perform cluster sweep for kmeans (silhouette width, wcss)
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 5)

out_test <- foreach(i = c("count_knn_20","count_knn_40","count_steinbock", "count_exp_40", "count_exp_20"), .combine = rbind)%dopar%{

set.seed(22)
clust_list <- lapply(2:20, function(k){
  cur_km <- kmeans(scale(colData(sce_spatial)[,i]), centers = k, nstart = 10)
  return(list(wss = sum(cur_km$withinss),
           clusters = cur_km$cluster))
})

sil <- vapply(lapply(clust_list, `[[`, 2), 
              function(x) mean(approxSilhouette(scale(colData(sce_spatial)[,i]), x)$width), 
              0)

data.frame(k = 2:20, 
           sil = sil,
           wss = unlist(lapply(clust_list, `[[`, 1)), 
           type = i)
}


ggplot(out_test, aes(x = k, y = sil, color = type))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("k")+
  ylab("Mean silhouette width")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")

ggplot(out_test, aes(x = k, y = wss, color = type))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("k")+
  ylab("Total WCSS")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")

ggplot(out_test %>% filter(!type %in% c("count_knn_40","count_knn_20")), aes(x = k, y = wss, color = type))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("k")+
```

```{r}
set.seed(22)

h_com <- Heatmap(for_plot, 
        col = viridis(100), 
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        #row_km = 11, row_km_repeats = 100, 
        cluster_rows = avg_col_dend_MCP,
        row_split = 10,
        name = "Fraction per community")+
  Heatmap(scale(for_plot), clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2")

h_com <- draw(h_com)
row_order_h_com <- row_order(h_com)
```

### Extract district 

```{r}
anno <- data.frame(myeloid_community = rownames(for_plot), position = seq_along(rownames(for_plot)))

anno$metacluster <- NA
anno$metacluster_1 <- NA

# From Heatmap order 
row_order_h_com
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_com))%do%{
anno$metacluster <- ifelse(anno$position %in% row_order_h_com[[i]], i,anno$metacluster)
}

# From dendrogram (only relevant for agnes)
branches <- cutree(avg_col_dend_MCP, k = 10)

samples_per_branch <- lapply(unique(branches), function(branch) {
  names(branches)[branches == branch]
})

foreach(i = seq_along(samples_per_branch))%do%{
anno$metacluster_1 <- ifelse(anno$myeloid_community %in% samples_per_branch[[i]], i,anno$metacluster_1)
}

#all.equal(anno$metacluster, anno$metacluster_1)

## Add to SCE 
sce$myeloid_district <- paste0("D_",anno$metacluster[match(sce$myeloid_community, anno$myeloid_community)])
sce$myeloid_district[sce$myeloid_district == "D_NA"] <- NA
```

# 7. Differential abundance analysis 


## Loop over categories 

### Myeloid cluster 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$my_cluster_names), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```


```{r}
library(ggnewscale)

DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
#DA_out <- DA_out %>% filter(category %in% c("pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x = cluster, y = category, col = logFC, size = -log10(FDR))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8") +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 10)) +
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

### ISUP grade

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$my_cluster_110), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]
meta$ISUP_combined <- relevel(x=factor(meta$ISUP_combined), ref = "1/2")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$ISUP_combined),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$ISUP_combined)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ISUP_combined, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined))%v%
  columnAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

# 8. Survival analysis 

## Cox hazard models

## Cluster 

### Continious 

```{r cox}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_my_cluster_names <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_my_cluster_names <- PID_my_cluster_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_my_cluster_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "my_cluster_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
#colnames(PID_metagroups) <- paste0("MY_",colnames(PID_metagroups))

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-OS_months, -status_OS,-HLADR_hi) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ HLADR_hi"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

### Mean / Median 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_my_cluster_names <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(my_cluster_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_my_cluster_names <- PID_my_cluster_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_my_cluster_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "my_cluster_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
#colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("MY", colnames(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Myeloid clusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

```{r}
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

### GMM

```{r}
PID_myeloid_district_names <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_district_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_myeloid_district_names <- PID_myeloid_district_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_myeloid_district_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_district_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

PID_metagroups <- na.omit(PID_metagroups)
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
#colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("MY_", colnames(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (GMM division of cluster proportions)
Cox_df_GMM <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
GMM_Cox <- Mclust(Cox_df[,i], G = 2)
as.character(GMM_Cox$classification)
}

colnames(Cox_df_GMM) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_GMM) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_GMM <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_GMM,stringsAsFactors=TRUE)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_GMM$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_GMM$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_GMM$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_GMM$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_GMM$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_GMM$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_GMM %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_GMM)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_GMM <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_GMM <- ggplot(plot_df_GMM, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_GMM")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_GMM
```

```{r}
hr_mean/
```

### Cluster-level

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique()

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  cur_surv[,x] <- Cox_df_mean[,x][match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = cur_surv)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[2], exp_2 = fit$exp[2])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.05, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out))

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(FDR)")
```

## AgM based patient groups

```{r}
set.seed(22)
sce$myeloid_metacluster_comb <- ifelse(sce$myeloid_metacluster == "Ag_M", "Ag_M", "Not_Ag_M")

## Define patient groups 
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster_comb,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))


ggplot(PID_myeloid_metacluster, aes(x=PID, y=fra, fill = myeloid_metacluster_comb))+
  geom_tile(position = "fill")

plot_heat_PID <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, values_from = fra, names_from = myeloid_metacluster_comb) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
plot_heat_PID[is.na(plot_heat_PID)] <- 0

testCL<- clValid(plot_heat_PID,nClust = 2:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),validation="internal",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)

#set.seed(22)
#library(dendextend)
#avg_dend_obj_MCP <- as.dendrogram(agnes(plot_heat_PID,metric = "euclidean",method = "ward"))
#avg_col_dend_MCP <- color_branches(avg_dend_obj_MCP, k = 3)
#plot(avg_col_dend_MCP)

h <- Heatmap(plot_heat_PID,
             name = "Proportion",
             col = viridis(100), 
             row_km = 3, 
             row_km_repeats = 100,
             #cluster_rows = avg_col_dend_MCP,
             #row_split=3,
             show_row_names = FALSE)

h <- draw(h)

row_order_h <- row_order(h)

anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID) %>% unique()
anno$my_HLADR_group <- NA

for(i in seq_along(row_order_h)){
anno$my_HLADR_group <- as.factor(ifelse(anno$PID %in% rownames(plot_heat_PID)[row_order_h[[i]]], i, anno$my_HLADR_group))
}

## Add to SCE
sce$my_AgM_group <- anno$my_HLADR_group[match(sce$PID, anno$PID)]

## Give meaningful names 
sce$my_AgM_group <- unfactor(sce$my_AgM_group)
sce$my_AgM_group[sce$my_AgM_group == "1"] <- "AgM_med"
sce$my_AgM_group[sce$my_AgM_group == "2"] <- "AgM_low"
sce$my_AgM_group[sce$my_AgM_group == "3"] <- "AgM_high"
sce$my_AgM_group <- factor(sce$my_AgM_group)
```

### Differential abundance testing 

#### Cluster level 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

sce_selected <- sce[,sce$my_AgM_group %in% c("AgM_low","AgM_high")]

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce_selected$my_cluster_names), sce_selected$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_selected)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_selected$PID),]
meta$my_AgM_group <- relevel(x=factor(meta$my_AgM_group), ref = "AgM_low")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$my_AgM_group),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$my_AgM_group)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~my_AgM_group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$my_AgM_group))%v%
  columnAnnotation(my_AgM_group = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$my_AgM_group)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

```{r}
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

#### District level 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

sce_selected <- sce[,sce$my_AgM_group %in% c("AgM_low","AgM_high")]

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce_selected$myeloid_district_names), sce_selected$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% names(colSums(abundances))[colSums(abundances) != 0]]
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_selected)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_selected$PID),]
meta$my_AgM_group <- relevel(x=factor(meta$my_AgM_group), ref = "AgM_low")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$my_AgM_group),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$my_AgM_group)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~my_AgM_group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$my_AgM_group))%v%
  columnAnnotation(my_AgM_group = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$my_AgM_group)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  #scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$my_cluster_130)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID) %>% unique() %>% as.data.frame

rownames(PID_metagroups) <- NULL
rownames(PID_metagroups) <- PID_metagroups$PID

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

Cox_df$my_HLADR_group <- factor(sce$my_HLADR_group[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)], levels = c("3","2","1"))

Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
Cox_df$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])

#Based on patient groups
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -PID) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res_1 <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop_1 <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res_1$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res_1$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res_1$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res_1$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res_1$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res_1$waldtest["pvalue"],3))


#Plot hazard ratiOS
#hr_prop <- 
ggplot(plot_df_prop_1, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("HLA_DR_groups")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
#scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

```{r}
## Compare fraction of PDL1-positive myeloid cells across clinical categories 
n_cat <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(PID, PDL1_score_cells) %>% count()

out_dat$pT_combined <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(out_dat$PID,sce$PID)])

cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = all_plots)
```

```{r}
  myeloid_metacluster = anno_barplot(myeloid_metacluster, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = col)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(3,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

# Number of cells and PID 
n_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID_metagroups,PID) %>% group_by(PID_metagroups) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(Freq != 0) %>% group_by(PID_metagroups) %>% dplyr::count()

n_cell_id <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID_metagroups,cell_id) %>% group_by(PID_metagroups) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(Freq != 0) %>% group_by(PID_metagroups) %>% dplyr::count()

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cell_id$n, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        
                             n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),
                             border = TRUE, 
                             annotation_name_rot = 90,
                             gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                             which = "row")


# Define names for districts
anno <- myeloid_metacluster %>% rownames_to_column("metagroups")
anno$metagroups_match <- anno$metagroups

anno$metagroups[anno$metagroups == "1"] <- "AgM_dom"
anno$metagroups[anno$metagroups == "2"] <- "M1_dom"
anno$metagroups[anno$metagroups == "3"] <- "MDSC_dom"
anno$metagroups[anno$metagroups == "4"] <- "M2_dom"
#anno$metagroups[anno$metagroups == "5"] <- "M1_dom"


## Add names to sce
sce$PID_metagroups_names <- factor(anno$metagroups[match(sce$PID_metagroups, anno$metagroups_match)])

# Plot heatmap 
Heatmap(for_metagroups, col = viridis(100), row_names_side = "left", row_labels = anno$metagroups)+
  ha_my+
  Heatmap(for_metagroups_fine, col = viridis(100))+
  ha_meta
```

#### Nested model testing 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(OS_months, status_OS, gender, age, pT_combined, ISUP_combined, PID_metagroups) %>% unique()

cur_surv <- na.omit(cur_surv) 

covariates_null <- cur_surv %>% select(-OS_months, -status_OS, -PID_metagroups) %>% colnames
multi_formula_null <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates_null, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model_null <- coxph(multi_formula_null, data = cur_surv)

covariates_full <- cur_surv %>% select(-OS_months, -status_OS) %>% colnames
multi_formula_full <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates_full, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model_full <- coxph(multi_formula_full, data = cur_surv)

# Log-likelihood ratio test
anova(multi_model_null, multi_model_full)
```


## Based on myeloid densities 

NOTE: Here, I am row-scaling the densities per PID to retrieve patient groups, which is in fact the exact SAME as row-scaling the proportions per PID. 

### Myeloid metacluster 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

# Mean tissue area per PID
PID_area <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_myeloid_metacluster$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_myeloid_metacluster$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

# Select PID with more than 10 myeloid cells
PID_select <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(total = sum(Freq)) %>% filter(total >= 10) %>% 
  pull(PID) %>% unique() %>% unfactor() 

PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% filter(PID %in% PID_select)

PID_metagroups <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

#Option: A: Row-scaled (per PID)
PID_metagroups_scaled <- t(scale(as.matrix(t(PID_metagroups))))
#col_scaled <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 2, 3), c("#A278FAFF", "#F1E9E7FF", "#FF8061FF", "#FF0000FF"))

### 1. Cluster-testing
library(clValid)
#Internal measures
testCL<- clValid(PID_metagroups_scaled,nClust = 2:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),validation="internal",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL)

#Stability measures 
testCL_1<- clValid(PID_metagroups_scaled,nClust = 2:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),validation="stability",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")
summary(testCL_1)
plot(testCL_1, legend = FALSE)

#Selected method: agnes, 4
set.seed(22)
library(dendextend)
avg_dend_obj_MCP <- as.dendrogram(agnes(PID_metagroups_scaled,metric = "euclidean",method = "ward"))
avg_col_dend_MCP <- color_branches(avg_dend_obj_MCP, k = 4)
plot(avg_col_dend_MCP)

# Print heatmap
h_g <- Heatmap(PID_metagroups_scaled, name = "Cluster fraction", 
        col = viridis(100),
        row_km = 4, 
        row_km_repeats = 2000,
        #cluster_rows = avg_col_dend_MCP,
        #row_split = 4,
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2")

h_g <- draw(h_g)
draw(h_g)

#Retrieve PID groups
library(foreach)
row_groups <- foreach(i = 1:4, .combine = rbind) %do%{
data.frame(PID = rownames(PID_metagroups[row_order(h_g)[[i]],]), PID_group = i)
}

#Add to sce
sce$PID_metagroups_scaled <- row_groups$PID_group[match(sce$PID,row_groups$PID)]
```


```{r}
#Assess survival impact 
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  select(PID, PID_metagroups_scaled, pT_combined, OS_months, status_OS) %>% 
  #mutate(PID_metagroups_2 = ifelse(PID_metagroups %in% c("2","3"),"2/3",PID_metagroups)) %>%
  #filter(PID_metagroups %in% c("1","4")) %>% 
  #filter(pT_combined == "3/4") %>% 
  unique()

#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ PID_metagroups_scaled, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
```

## Based on myeloid of immune proportions 

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")
```

### Myeloid metacluster 

```{r pgroups, eval = F}
PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Filter for myeloid cells 
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined[str_detect(PID_celltype_combined$celltype_combined, "MY"),]

# Filter for patients that have at least 5 myeloid cells
PID_select <- PID_celltype_combined %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(total = sum(Freq)) %>% filter(total >= 5) %>% 
  pull(PID) %>% unique()

PID_metagroups <- PID_celltype_combined %>% filter(PID %in% PID_select) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

#double-check that rowsums are 1 
rowSums(PID_metagroups)

#Option: Column-scaled
PID_metagroups_scaled <- scale(as.matrix(PID_metagroups))
#col_scaled <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 2, 3), c("#A278FAFF", "#F1E9E7FF", "#FF8061FF", "#FF0000FF"))

### 1. Cluster-testing

#Internal measures
testCL<- clValid(PID_metagroups,nClust = 2:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),validation="internal",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL)

#Stability measures 
testCL_1<- clValid(PID_metagroups,nClust = 2:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),validation="stability",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")

#Selected method: agnes, 4

library(dendextend)
avg_dend_obj_MCP <- as.dendrogram(agnes(PID_metagroups,metric = "euclidean",method = "ward"))
avg_col_dend_MCP <- color_branches(avg_dend_obj_MCP, k = 5)
plot(avg_col_dend_MCP)

# Print heatmap
h_g <- Heatmap(PID_metagroups, name = "Cluster fraction", 
        col = viridis(100),
        row_km = 5, 
        row_km_repeats = 2000,
        #cluster_rows = avg_col_dend_MCP,
        #row_split = 5,
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2")

h_g <- draw(h_g)
draw(h_g)

#Retrieve PID groups
library(foreach)
row_groups <- foreach(i = 1:5, .combine = rbind) %do%{
data.frame(PID = rownames(PID_metagroups[row_order(h_g)[[i]],]), PID_group = i)
}

#Add to sce
sce$PID_metagroups_immune <- row_groups$PID_group[match(sce$PID,row_groups$PID)]
```
